pois.name: Olympus Mons
pois.summary: Largest volcano in the Solar System by volume, a vast shield in western Tharsis rising more than 21 km above the Martian datum. Its summit caldera complex spans tens of kilometers across a gently sloping basaltic edifice.

pois.name: Valles Marineris
pois.summary: Enormous equatorial canyon system east of Tharsis, stretching thousands of kilometers with depths of several kilometers. Its chasmata expose layered wall rock and host landslide and outflow deposits that record a long tectonic and erosional history.
